name: foundry-homebrew
description: FoundryVTT macros for Shadowdark and The Lost Citadel

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npx bddgen --config tests/playwright.config.js && npx playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.js
scripts.test:headed: npx bddgen --config tests/playwright.config.js && npx playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.js --headed
scripts.test:debug: npx bddgen --config tests/playwright.config.js && npx playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.js --debug
